Three cases by the number of coordinate axes in the set. All three are closed by Glucose and, on the same formulas, by CaDiCaL; the proofs of the three-axis and four-axis cases were checked, and the five-axis case is split into 81 sub-cases with one proof each (all 81 proofs verified). Engine A (CP-SAT) closed only the three-axis case; 'two engines' here means the SAT solvers Glucose and CaDiCaL. The value 29 was reported before as the smallest set generated from these coordinates, without proof.
